comment: Hand-settled cases that tools/seed_symbols.py cannot decide on its own.
Keyed by symbol id (the header identifier minus its _name / _sig suffix).
'owner' pins one candidate when an intermediary id appears on several classes
in an override chain; a full official triple seeds a symbol the base version
does not have at all. 'resolve_from' names the version the triple was read on.
'versions' carries per-version corrections: [{since, until, owner, name, desc,
class}]. Later matching rules win. Most of them were produced by
tools/find_renames.py, which follows Fabric's intermediary id -- stable across
Mojang renames -- to prove that a symbol the spec calls missing is really just
'blocked_by' on a rule means the symbol was FOUND but must not be bound yet,
because its call shape changed and the existing caller would pass or read the
wrong thing. The triple stays as documentation, the symbol reports absent, and
the feature degrades visibly instead of corrupting a value or a stack frame.

living_entity_get_equipped_stack.why: class_1309 is what every call site resolves on; EquipmentUser is the interface that also declares it

block_entity_get_pos.why: storage_esp calls it on the block entity itself, not through RandomizableContainer

keyboard_input_tick.name: tick
keyboard_input_tick.why: the override the game actually runs. LocalPlayer.input is declared ClientInput but holds a KeyboardInput, and KeyboardInput overrides tick on every version -- so a hook on ClientInput.tick attaches happily and never fires

versions.why: the slowdown arguments were dropped in 1.21.4

input_forward.name: forwardImpulse
input_forward.why: Input became the immutable PlayerInput record in 1.21.2, so 1.21.11 has no such field

versions.why: 1.21.2 split the key presses into an immutable record but kept forwardImpulse as a mutable field, now on ClientInput. 1.21.5 replaced both impulses with ClientInput.moveVector
1.21.2 split the key presses into an immutable record but kept leftImpulse as a mutable field, now on ClientInput. 1.21.5 replaced both impulses with ClientInput.moveVector

versions.name: mainCamera
versions.why: GameRenderer.getMainCamera lost its get- prefix in 26.2

versions.name: pick
versions.why: the interaction raycast moved off GameRenderer onto Minecraft in 26.1; same shape, different owner, which is why the table carries the owner class
GameRenderer.getFov returned double until 1.21.2. sdk::compat::field_of_view picks CallDoubleMethod or CallFloatMethod from the bound descriptor's return type

versions.name: getFov
versions.why: FOV state moved onto Camera in 26.1 and the getter lost its arguments. The same helper reads the arity off the descriptor, so the call site does not branch on a version number

26.3 reworked swings into item components: swing(InteractionHand) gained a SwingAnimation argument and a boolean return. sdk::compat::swing_hand reads the arity off the descriptor and passes SwingAnimation.DEFAULT

swing_animation_default.name: DEFAULT
swing_animation_default.why: the stock swing; what an attack that carries no item-specific animation should send

versions.why: TridentItem.onStoppedUsing gained a boolean return in 1.21.2. tick_movement_hook registers a void-returning callback for the older shape, chosen from the bound descriptor

versions.name: getYRot
versions.why: Camera.getYRot was renamed getYaw in 1.21.11; same ()F, pure rename

versions.name: getXRot
versions.why: renamed getPitch in 1.21.11; same ()F
1.21.11 moved the horse package; the class is otherwise the same
follows horse_class through the package move
the mutable Input class; 1.21.2 replaced it with the PlayerInput record
tick lived on Input itself before 1.21.2 split the key presses into a record
moved to ClientInput but kept the slowdown arguments until 1.21.4 dropped them
the field holds the mutable Input before 1.21.2; read as jobject either way

versions.name: setSelectedHotbarSlot
versions.why: renamed setSelectedSlot in 1.21.5; same (I)V. Before 1.21.2 there is no setter at all and the selected slot is written as a field

1.20.2 split the common listener out and send(Packet) moved to ClientCommonPacketListenerImpl with a new intermediary id, so the rename finder cannot follow it. Call sites resolve on the live handler object, which inherits it either way
1.20.3 moved the declaration; returns a Component either way
the return type narrowed to PlayerTeam in 1.20.3; jobject either way
fallDistance was a float until 1.21.5 and is a double after. sdk/minecraft/entity/entity.cpp picks its accessor from the bound descriptor, so both shapes read correctly
first argument follows fallDistance from float to double in 1.21.5. No C++ caller today; the rule keeps the table honest
the level render signature changes nearly every release. Nothing hooks it -- the header keeps it as a documented dead end -- so the rule exists to stop it reading as a missing symbol

vec2_class.why: the movement vector ClientInput exposes from 1.21.5 on; constructed to write input

living_renderer_render.name: render

versions.blocked_by: 1.21.2 moved the model's pitch into a render state, which update_render_state hooks. Binding this as well would apply the pitch swap twice on any version that kept both.
versions.why: superseded by updateRenderState

living_renderer_render.why: where the model's pitch is sampled before 1.21.2: LivingEntityRenderer.render itself

abstract_chest_block_class.why: storage ESP matches block states against this parent class: covers both chests and ender chests

barrel_block_class.why: storage ESP matches block states against this parent class: barrels

shulker_box_block_class.why: storage ESP matches block states against this parent class: shulker boxes

hopper_block_class.why: storage ESP matches block states against this parent class: hoppers

dispenser_block_class.why: storage ESP matches block states against this parent class: dispensers and droppers

crafter_block_class.why: storage ESP matches block states against this parent class: crafters (1.21+)

abstract_furnace_block_class.why: storage ESP matches block states against this parent class: furnaces, smokers, blast furnaces

vec3i_get_x.name: getX
vec3i_get_x.why: BlockPos extends Vec3i; this is how a block entity's coordinates are read

vec3i_get_y.name: getY
vec3i_get_y.why: BlockPos extends Vec3i; this is how a block entity's coordinates are read

vec3i_get_z.name: getZ
vec3i_get_z.why: BlockPos extends Vec3i; this is how a block entity's coordinates are read

pick_range.name: getPickRange
pick_range.why: where the interaction distance comes from before 1.20.5, which replaced it with the entity_interaction_range attribute. Returns float, not double, so the hook needs its own callback

dyeable_item_class.why: the interface dyed armour implements before 1.20.5 made the colour a component

dyeable_get_color.name: getColor
dyeable_get_color.why: reads the dye colour off the item itself; replaced in 1.20.5 by the static DyedItemColor helper, which is why this is an instance call and that one is static

entity_get_pitch_noarg.name: getXRot
entity_get_pitch_noarg.why: the pitch as it stands, not interpolated. entity_get_pitch is getViewXRot(F)F, the tick-delta variant, which is why two hooks used to name the no-arg getter by hand in intermediary -- and therefore resolved nothing at all on 26.x or vanilla

camera_align_with_entity.name: alignWithEntity
camera_align_with_entity.why: where the camera reads the entity's interpolated rotation. Hooked as a probe: it is the one place that can say whether the view is being fed a faked angle
